sources.title: The SQLite R*Tree Module
sources.exact_locator: Sections 3.1 (virtual table, 32-bit bounds), 3.4 (Roundoff Error: outward rounding; expand contained-within boxes), 3.5 (SQLITE_LOCKED read/write), 4 (Key Point: index narrows, does not decide), 7.2 (rtreecheck)
sources.applicability: Direct precedent for bounded spatial storage/viewport access in the project DB; edge-rounding and read-while-write limits adopted as design rules.

sources.title: Write-Ahead Logging (SQLite)
sources.exact_locator: Section 1 (advantages/disadvantages), 2 (atomic commit via WAL; checkpointing), 2.3 (synchronous NORMAL durability tradeoff), 3.3 (WAL mode persistence), 4 (The WAL File: 'part of the persistent state... keep with the database if copied or moved')
sources.applicability: Mechanism for interrupted-save recovery and the bundle relocation/checkpoint rule; durability configuration choices.

sources.title: PROJ FAQ (PROJ 9.9.0 documentation)
sources.exact_locator: Section 'Why is the axis ordering in PROJ not consistent?' (authority axis order per ISO 19111; EPSG:4326 WKT2 shows AXIS lat ORDER 1; projinfo check); Section 'What is the best format...' (WKT2 preferred, PROJ-string conversions lossy); Section 'Cannot find proj.db' (proj.db runtime requirement, PROJ_DATA search path)
sources.applicability: Authority for axis-order handling, CRS description format choice, and the offline proj.db bundling requirement.

sources.title: RFC 7946: The GeoJSON Format
sources.exact_locator: Section 3.1.1 (position = longitude, latitude 'precisely in that order'; optional third element altitude); Section 4 (WGS84/CRS84; third element metres above WGS84 ellipsoid; alternative CRSs removed for interoperability); 3.1.9 (antimeridian cutting SHOULD); 3.2 (Feature geometry null for unlocated); 5.2 (antimeridian bbox [177,-20,-178,-16]); 3.1.10 (digit count is not uncertainty)
sources.applicability: Export format contract for the map overlay and the null-geometry treatment of incomplete coordinates.

sources.title: OGR CRS and Coordinate Transformation tutorial (GDAL stable docs)
sources.exact_locator: Section 'CRS and axis order': pre-3.0 GDAL stripped authority axis order; GDAL 3.0+ honours it by default (OAMS_AUTHORITY_COMPLIANT); SetAxisMappingStrategy(OAMS_TRADITIONAL_GIS_ORDER) as explicit lon/lat data-order escape hatch; WKT1 export shows AXIS[Latitude,NORTH] for EPSG:4326
sources.applicability: Documented precedent that axis order is a recurring interoperability defect class and that an explicit data-order-vs-CRS-order mapping strategy is the established mitigation.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap Copyright and License page
sources.exact_locator: 'OpenStreetMap licensing' (ODbL; credit + state ODbL; share alike if altered); 'How to credit' (attribution notice required); 'Additional services': 'we cannot provide a free-of-charge map API or map tiles for third-parties' with links to API/Tile/Nominatim Usage Policies
sources.applicability: Licensing facts for bundling OSM-derived map extracts: attribution + ODbL statement required; OSMF tile servers are not a bulk source.
